prompt: Which correctly overrides toString() for a class with fields 'name' and 'age'?
choices: public String toString() { return name + age; }
@Override public String toString() { return "Person{name='" + name + "', age=" + age + "}"; }
public static String toString(Person p) { return p.name; }
explanation: toString() must be public, non-static, return String, and use @Override. A readable format like 'ClassName{field=value}' helps debugging. Option A omits @Override and separator. Option C is static. Option D returns void.
